# Bloom UI — Full LLM Documentation Reference

> Complete technical documentation for all components in the Bloom UI ecosystem.

## CLI Setup Guide
Initialize Bloom UI:
```bash
npx @bloomui-react/cli init
```

Add any component:
```bash
npx @bloomui-react/cli add <component-name>
```
